# October 2025 Development Updates #1


[Reclaim Protocol](https://substack.com/@reclaimprotocol)


Oct 13, 2025


Hey Subscribers,


We’re back with some exciting updates! In this edition, we cover everything from the release of our new architecture to the launch of the Student Ambassador Program.


And don’t miss the latest podcasts featuring


**Madhavan** on


**Code Story** and


**Biometric Update** , where he dives into the vision and tech behind Reclaim Protocol.


Stay informed and enjoy the read!


### Introducing Reclaim Protocol New Architecture:


We’re excited to share the brand-new architecture, We’ve moved beyond the challenges of our previous proxy-based ZK-TLS model. Our innovative solution now utilizes two Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), now user interact directly with the website, eliminating the key shortcomings of earlier proxy-based approach.


At the heart of this design are two specialized TEEs: TEE-K, which securely manages TLS keys and handles all encryption and decryption, and TEE-A, which assists with authentication tag computation without ever accessing the sensitive TLS keys. This ingenious “split AEAD” (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) mechanism, coupled with a focus on single request-response TLS sessions, drastically boosts efficiency by eliminating the need for computationally intensive zero-knowledge proofs.


Interested in gaining deeper insights into our new architecture? Refer to


**Section 3** of our


**[whitepaper](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Tok4J6mv7PwRCbwxVNhv4alS82sQJI4E/view)** for a comprehensive overview.

## Announcing the Reclaim Student Ambassador Program!


**The Reclaim Student Ambassador Program** - a volunteer opportunity designed for curious and driven students from colleges and universities across India.


Apply here:


[https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4310958084/](https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4310958084/)


**What You’ll Do**


As a Reclaim Student Ambassador, you’ll:


-


Support ongoing projects and verification tasks


-


Help test real-world use cases involving AI and cryptography


-


Contribute to shaping how global-scale verification systems are designed and deployed


This is a great opportunity to dive deep into emerging tech, even if you’re just starting out. No prior experience is required - just curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn!


We truly value your time and effort. Here’s what you can expect in return:


-


🎯


**Mentorship** from professionals working at the intersection of AI and Web3


-


🧠


**Resume-building support** including recommendation letters


-


🚀


**Referrals** for internships at YC-backed startups and partner companies


#### Who Can Apply?


-


Students currently enrolled in any college or university in India


-


Must have access to your college/university portal (for enrollment verification)


-


Interest in AI, cryptography, or emerging technologies is a plus - but not mandatory!


This Student Ambassador program is targeted towards Indian students. We’ll launch the Global Student Ambassador program in the near future.
